gary_2026_10_29_ai_ml_lecture_networking.title: AI/ML Lecture & Networking @ Intuit
gary_2026_10_29_ai_ml_lecture_networking.label: Tech / AI
gary_2026_10_29_ai_ml_lecture_networking.summary: Gary's Guide: A monthly ML research colloquium by the New York Machine Learning Research Guild - this session in collaboration with our partner, Intuit. The Mathematical Theory of Deep Learning Arthur Jacot Assistant Professor, Courant Institute of Mathematical Sciences, NYU Topic: TBD This session is a close-quarters look at that theory, with plenty of room to push back & dig in. About Arthur Arthur Jacot is an Assistant Professor at NYU's Courant Institute of Mathematical Sciences. He builds mathematical theory for how deep neural networks learn, & is best known for introducing the Neural Tangent Kernel during a PhD at EPFL with Clment Hongler. Recent work explains how DNNs act as a computational Occam's razor, finding simple, low-dimensional representations when trained with weight decay: A proof that wide networks trained with weight decay exhibit neural collapse (ICLR 2025, oral) An account of how DNNs break the curse of dimensionality through compositionality & symmetry learning (ICLR 2025) A newer paper framing deep learning as a convex paradigm of computation that minimizes circuit size with ResNets Arthur's honors include the 2025 AMR Prize in Mathematics of Artificial Intelligence & the 2023 EPFL PhD Thesis Prize. Who this is for NY-MLR colloquia are small by design. The room is capped, & we keep it that way so the discussion stays substantive & everyone in it can contribute. We'd love to see you if you're: A practitioner working seriously on ML, in industry or in a lab A researcher or graduate student in ML, mathematics, or an adjacent field A highly motivated student or self-directed learner of any age or background, with real depth of interest Sincere interest is enough to belong - that's one of our core principles. What we ask is that you come ready to engage. More on the Guild & our ethos at nymlr.com. Schedule 5:00 - 5:30 PM Doors open, arrivals, mingling 5:30 - 6:30 PM Talk 6:30 - 7:00 PM Moderated Q&A 7:00 - 8:00 PM After hours, mingling, wind-down 8:00 PM Lights out Venue: Intuit NYC 51 Astor Pl, New York, NY 10003 Food & drinks Food & drinks are provided - another reason to claim your seat only if you can make it, & to release it if you can't. A note on no-shows Seats are strictly limited by room capacity, & every in-person RSVP takes one from someone else who wanted it. If you register to attend in person & your plans change, please amend your registration or cancel on Luma. It takes ten seconds & frees the seat. Registering in person & not showing up without updating your RSVP will forfeit your access to future NY-MLR events. Please mark your attendance mode accurately. A note on Unapproved Attendance Due to limited capacity & security reasons, we will not be able to accept & accommodate unapproved drop-ins to the event, so please do not drop by uninvited as you'll be turned away by security. We apologize for the inconvenience & inability to accommodate everyone for this particular session, but please feel free to join us on our next one. Thank you for your understanding.

gary_2026_10_29_is_everything_predictabl.title: Is Everything Predictable - AI, Prediction Markets & Philosophy Of Foresight
gary_2026_10_29_is_everything_predictabl.label: Tech / AI
gary_2026_10_29_is_everything_predictabl.summary: Gary's Guide: In this six-week course, explore works from philosophy, cultural studies, & journalism to understand how technologies that predict the future also shape the present.The age of AI, prediction markets, & real-time data analysis brings predictive reasoning into all corners of human life. Once considered a niche academic interest area, the philosophy & politics of prediction is now relevant to everybody. Is Everything Predictable?: AI, Prediction Markets, & the Philosophy of Foresight presents scholarly material on forecasting technologies in a rigorous but highly accessible format.Drawing from a range of sources, we center scholarly texts & deeply-researched journalism that uncover the links between digital calculation, philosophical notions of time & free will, & the reality of living in an age where everything seems reducible to calculation.Guest speakers from academia & tech journalism will round out our seminar sessions, & for our final meeting, students have the option of presenting original research or creative work in an event open to the general public.SyllabusIn the early weeks of the course, we read texts from contemporary media studies & political theory that construe prediction & speculation as forms of governance. We also address probabilistic reasoning as a key feature of artificial intelligence & prediction market mechanisms, using frameworks suitable for participants without any background in STEM. As we will see, the similarities & differences between how probability works in AI versus prediction markets have much to tell us about these tools effects on everything from global warfare & the environment to creativity & personal relationships.After establishing a strong practical & theoretical foundation in AI & prediction markets, we turn to philosophical writing on the nature of freedom, self-expression, & power. These texts urge us to ask whether predictive technologies empower us with highly advanced forms of knowledge; if they inhibit us by constraining our imagination of whats possible; or if both of these outcomes might be true at once. We also read articles & listen to podcast interviews with our guest speakers in anticipation of their visits.Throughout our sessions, we examine case studies related to tech companies, specific applications, & major actors in the AI & prediction market space. The courses culminating event a salon open to the general public reflects our interest in connecting questions & concerns that seem highly academic to current events & everyday life. Students who choose to give presentations will participate in an additional workshop or one-on-one advising session to help them prepare. By the courses end, we will be able to navigate a world driven by predictive technologies with greater clarity, confidence, & wisdom, & to share our perspectives on them in a way that empowers those around us.Learning OutcomesConnect AI & prediction market functionalities to political & cultural affairsDevelop critical reading skills applicable to philosophy & journalismApply frameworks from the theoretical humanities to real-world developments in politics & technologyMake scholarly ideas accessible to a wide range of audiencesScholarshipsIndex scholarships are designed to benefit underrepresented groups, BIPOC members of our community, & those for whom the class price is not accessible. These need-based scholarships will go to the candidates who best demonstrate why they should be chosen for the free spot to our class. You can apply for a scholarship here.Instructor BioEmma Stamm is a writer & professor with a background in philosophy & the social study of science & technology (STS). She holds a PhD in Interdisciplinary Studies from Virginia Tech & has taught courses on the philosophy & social implications of technology at Villanova University, Virginia Tech, the Acid Horizon Research Commons, New York University, where she currently teaches for the Department of Media, Culture, & Communication. As a public-facing scholar, she has written for Vice Motherboard, Real Life Mag, & Communications of the Association for Computing Machinery, in addition to co-hosting the LEPHT HAND podcast. She is the co-founder & Executive Director of theLenox Institute for Advanced Study, which makes critical science & tech education accessible beyond academia.RefundsWe get that things come up, but we rely on headcounts to make our programs viable. If you request a refund...More than 4 weeks before the program begins 100% refundMore than 2 weeks before the program begins 50% refundFewer than 2 weeks before the program begins No refundThanks for understanding & for supporting our ability to provide cool offerings through your purchase.Media Release ClauseBy attending this event, you consent to being photographed, filmed, or recorded, & grant Index Space permission to use this content for promotional or informational purposes.

gary_2026_10_30_how_to_get_your_startups.title: How To Get Your Startups Finances In Order
gary_2026_10_30_how_to_get_your_startups.label: Startup / Business
gary_2026_10_30_how_to_get_your_startups.place: Resident Company Club (Flatiron), To Be Announced
gary_2026_10_30_how_to_get_your_startups.summary: Gary's Guide: Whether you've raised funding, started generating revenue, or are building your business, do you have a system to track where the money goes? When a co-founder pays for something personally, how is that expense recorded, approved & reimbursed? Can you see what has been paid, what is still outstanding, & where the supporting documents are? Getting your finances organised starts with the processes you use every day. In this Lunch & Learn, we'll explore how to build simple financial systems that help you manage your startup's money & understand your business as it grows. What we'll cover Your DocumentationWhat invoices, receipts, contracts & payment records should you capture-and how can you keep them organised? Your Financial ProcessesHow can you set up a consistent system for invoicing, payments, expense claims & founder reimbursements, so nothing gets missed or paid twice? Your BookkeepingHow do your everyday records become reliable accounts, & what should you keep updated each month? Your NumbersWhat can revenue, margins, profit, cash flow & runway tell you-and which numbers should you regularly review? Your Business DecisionsHow can your numbers help you plan spending, assess pricing & decide whether you can afford your next hire? Your Readiness for OpportunitiesHow can organised records & clear financial reports help you prepare information for tax filing, grant applications & funding conversations? This session is perfect for startup founders, entrepreneurs & early-stage teams-including those who have already raised funding-who want to establish practical financial systems & better understand their business performance. Presented by Mathura Kannan, ICAEW Chartered Accountant, Managing Director of Simply Empowering & Co-Founder of Expop, who works with businesses to set up financial processes, manage their accounting & turn their numbers into useful insights.

gary_2026_11_03_ai_founder_funder_mixer.summary: Gary's Guide: ABOUT OUR HOSTS & SPONSORS The AI Furnace is NYC's largest & most active AI community. It was started by AI founders, Angela Mascarenas & Hamza Zaveri, who were based in NYC & London & started the org to support fellow AI founders & operators building in local cities outside of Cerebral Valley (San Francisco). It has since grown to a global community of 20,000 AI founders, operators & researchers & has since organized events in 4 countries & 7 cities including NYC, London, Paris, Dubai, Boston, DC, & Philly. Foley Hoag offers practical, forward-looking advice in the fast-changing world of artificial intelligence, including at the leading edge of generative & agentic technologies. We partner with the thought leaders driving innovation & the dreamers who are responsibly developing AI to transform our world for the better. Investors, entrepreneurs, inventors, enterprises of all sizes, & community players all seek the guidance that is informed by our deep understanding of AI's role in our future. Our work with AI-enabled technologies & businesses covers various industries & stages of growth, but follows a core guiding principle: At every turn, set the stage for AI innovation & then get out of the way. As a firm, we walk the talk. We have deployed best-in-class legal technology firm-wide. gary_2026_11_04_startup_pitch_mixer.title: Startup Pitch Mixer
gary_2026_11_04_startup_pitch_mixer.label: Startup / Business
gary_2026_11_04_startup_pitch_mixer.summary: Gary's Guide: Join our event in New York! We design Pitch & Networking nights to help founders sharpen their thinking through direct, candid feedback & to give strong investors access to serious teams. Our pitch night is complemented by a structured networking session before & after the pitch session. What to expect: Startups pitch live & receive focused feedback from angels & VC partners Structured networking session before & after the pitches Entrepreneurs, startup founders, & operators are joining to network, exchange ideas, & build strong connections Active investors & venture scouts joining to discover the best startups early Who you will meet at the event: Founders Investors, VC partners, Venture Scouts Marketers, Salespeople, Business Advisors Industry Disruptors AI Experts Entrepreneurs from Europe, Asia, & the United Kingdom We Welcome New Investors: We invite investors to our event to expand their network, get acquainted with new startups, evaluate them, share feedback, & participate in discussions with early-stage & serial founders. We offer complimentary tickets to institutional investors, angels, & venture scouts with a proven track record. If you'd like to access our database of promising startups or provide mentorship support to our best startups, please fill out this short Investor Application Form, & our team will contact you. Want to Pitch? A limited number of founders will have the opportunity to pitch their startup or business to a panel of investors & experts. 4-6 selected founders will pitch their startup, followed by a short Q&A where participants can ask questions & share feedback. Apply by filling out the Pitch Application Form & sending us your pitch deck. Spots are limited, & we select founders in advance. To maintain high-quality pitches, you are required to present with a pitch deck. We will share our pitching guide and, if you'd like, coach you so you're fully prepared for pitch night. The best startups will be featured across our social media & included in our investor newsletter. Requirements for attendees: Dress code: smart casual. Bring good energy. Join our event & secure your ticket today! About us: Startup Valley is a global event organizer hosting pitch nights in 25 cities since 2023. Since then, we have hosted 850 events for 40,000 attendees. Over these years, we connected countless outstanding early-stage startups to serious investors, & we are not planning to stop. We maintain strategic partnerships with VC funds in the US, Europe, & Asia to support our community. Do you have a question, a partnership proposal, or want to clarify something? Reach us at hello@startupvalley.club Agenda 18:00-18:30 - Registration: Guests register, receive badges, & event programs. This is an opportunity for casual networking, making first connections, & preparing for the event. 18:30-19:00 - Event Kickoff & Interactive Networking: Official welcome from the organizers with a brief overview of the event goals & schedule. Interactive networking session to connect with key contacts. 19:00-19:50 - Startup Pitch Session: Startups present their projects to investors & experts. Each team has 5 minutes to pitch, covering the project's core idea, business model, & target market. 19:50-21:00 - Chill & Networking: Participants enjoy casual conversations with investors, discuss collaboration opportunities, & exchange ideas over refreshments. FAQ Can I pitch? Yes! To pitch, please purchase a Pitch Ticket & fill out the Pitch Application Form. We will contact you to discuss & approve your pitch. The pitch duration is 5 minutes. You will also have some time to answer questions from the audience. How does the pitch go? Selected founders present on stage to the audience & the investors in the room. You get 5 minutes to pitch your idea, business model, target market, & investment ask, followed by a short Q&A. The best startups are featured across our social media channels & in the investor newsletter. Who will I meet? Founders, angel investors, VC partners, venture scouts, AI experts, engineers, operators, marketing & sales experts, & international entrepreneurs from across Europe, Asia, & the US. Do investors get free tickets? Yes! Please apply above or email hello@startupvalley.club, & we will issue a complimentary ticket for you & your team. Can I request a refund? Yes. Refunds are available if requested at least 1 day before the event start time. Please submit the refund request on the platform where you purchased your ticket, or email us at hello@startupvalley.club

gary_2026_11_04_growth_council_off_the_r.title: Growth Council - Off-The-Record Problem Solving For Scaling Founders
gary_2026_11_04_growth_council_off_the_r.label: Startup / Business
gary_2026_11_04_growth_council_off_the_r.summary: Gary's Guide: Are you a founder or entrepreneur? If so, you know that scaling your business past Seed & Series A can expose many gaps in your business all at once - talent/employee friction, messy positioning, legal nuances, capital efficiency...and the list goes on. And while most founder events only focus on panels with generic advice, our new event "The Growth Council" aims to do something different. The mission of this event is to give the founder community access to experts who can help you at your specific stage of growth. The Growth Council is a small-group, peer-to-peer advisory session built specifically for Seed to Series B founders who want to explore their challenges with experts from across the industry & outside their network. Founders will have access to experts in various areas, rotating at specific intervals to ensure they meet with as many experts as possible (think speed dating, but less awkward). These conversations are meant to challenge assumptions & empower founders with new perspectives on their most pressing problems. You'll walk away with fresh perspectives, a bigger network, & connections who can help facilitate you on your journey towards success. The Expert Council Bring us your founder questions, your bottlenecks, or gut-check a current decision & get actionable takeaways from those who have been there before. You'll meet with cross-functional leaders such as: TJ Allison (Sales Advisor & Executive Coach, TJAllison.com) - Sales expert who focuses on revenue & the "Inner Game" to grow revenue & sense of self. Simon Gibson (Fractional VP of Marketing, Formerly GIPHY) - Marketing leader who blends creative storytelling & data-driven strategy to build culturally relevant brands & scale businesses. Rebekah Huber (Cofounder, Kindred Works) - Ops specialist who builds the systems that give founders their time back. Anna Kaplan (Founder & CEO, Narrativ By AK) - Narrative & messaging specialist who helps founders craft a story that wins the room. Marc Kaufman (Partner, Potomac Law Group) - Intellectual property attorney specializing in creating IP assets that increase funding. Fractional CFO TBD Agenda 6:00 PM - 6:30 PM | Arrivals & Light Bites Casual networking over food & drinks before we kick off. 6:30 PM - 6:45 PM | Council & Sponsor Intros Quick, 60-second introductions from each expert on the specific fires they help extinguish. 6:45 PM - 7:45 PM | Growth Council Huddles Rotate at regular intervals. At each table, state your burning question, get sharp direct feedback from the functional expert, & compare notes with peer founders. 7:45 PM - 8:30 PM | Drinks & Direct Connections Informal wrap-up to continue conversations with experts & founders. Who Should Apply This event is strictly curated for Seed, Series A, & Series B founders / co-founders leading venture-backed tech startups. Capacity is strictly capped at 35 founders to maintain small group sizes & high-signal discussions. Requests to join will be reviewed to preserve the peer dynamic. Hosted By: Kindred Works - Fractional operations & employee engagement partners for high-growth startups. Narrativ by AK - Strategic positioning & narrative development for founders. gary_2026_11_04_pizza_build_mobile_app_h.title: Pizza & Build: Mobile App Hackathon
gary_2026_11_04_pizza_build_mobile_app_h.label: Tech / AI
gary_2026_11_04_pizza_build_mobile_app_h.summary: Gary's Guide: What's happening?Bilt.me is teaming up with Time Rich Club and WisprFlow, and Koah the ad network built for AI apps, to host Mobile App Hackathon Night in New York: an evening for getting a real mobile app out of your head and onto your phone, with AI. A friendly hackathon where the only rule is to ship something by the end of the night.Most app ideas never leave the Notes app. Tonight yours does. No code needed.Bring a fresh idea or something you've already started. Describe what you want in plain language, keep refining it, and leave with an app running on your phone that you can show people.All you need is a laptop and the willingness to call something done.You'll be hacking alongside founders, designers, coders and people with too many ideas in their Notes app. Come solo or bring a friend, and we'll help you find teammates.Why come?Build your app with Bilt.me, then hear from Koah on how AI apps start making money from day one. Pizza on usFormatTeams of one or two. A quick kickoff, then three hours of heads-down hacking with a clear finish line: get it working on your phone. We wrap with demos, so everyone sees what got shipped.What to expectA short intro to building with Bilt.meA quick look from Koah at how AI apps make moneyTime to hack, test on your phone and ask questionsFriendly feedback from the roomDemos at the endGood conversations and new people to build withWho is it for?Anyone who wants to stop thinking about an app and start shipping one: aspiring founders, designers, creatives, AI-curious builders, and people who have never written code.What to bring?A laptop Your phone An idea, or the app you've already startedCo-hosted with Time Rich ClubElla Molony Cook is an Australian 4x founder with 1 exit and an investor in Anthropic. She runs a community of 63K+ subscribers on Substack and has hosted 250+ founder and investor experiences.Time Rich Club is for founders, leaders and investors who refuse to choose between ambition and a life they love. Think world-class mentorship to build a life of impact: become visible, build authority with your voice, and craft the delegation system that gives you your time back.Their ethos: real wealth goes beyond finances. It's a deeper relationship with yourself and your mission, and the freedom to spend your time how you choose. Being ambitious can be lonely, so they built the resources, community and a non-judgmental space for you to show up as you are.Our partnerTime Rich runs on voice, powered by Wispr Flow. Wispr Flow turns your voice into clean written text in any app. Speak your emails, notes and ideas instead of typing them, plus a notetaker integrated within your AI stack. The fastest hours you'll ever win back.Seats are limited and we read every application.About Bilt.meBilt turns a plain-language idea into a real native mobile app, with the frontend, database and login all built for you, ready to test on your phone and publish to the App Store and Google Play.---When: Wednesday 4 November 2026Time: 6pm to 9pmWhere: New York, venue to be announced. We'll share the location with approved guests.Entry: FreeBilt.me credits: included, sponsoredHosted by Bilt.me in collaboration with Koah (koahlabs.com)We take pictures during this event and will use those pictures for marketing. If you don't wish to be photographed, let us know in advance and we can accommodate. Link to Bilt privacy policy: bilt.me/privacy

jc_culture_10003576_2026_11_11_hamilton_.title: Hamilton Park Farmers Market 2026
jc_culture_10003576_2026_11_11_hamilton_.label: Festival / Market
jc_culture_10003576_2026_11_11_hamilton_.place: Hamilton Park, 9 McWilliams Pl., Jersey City, NJ
jc_culture_10003576_2026_11_11_hamilton_.summary: Join us at the Hamilton Park Farmers Market, your midweek destination for fresh, local, and thoughtfully crafted food and goods. Each week, we’re proud to feature farm-fresh produce from Stony Hill Farm alongside a curated selection of specialty vendors. Browse a variety of offerings including our long time vendor Pickles and Olives, fresh seafood from Scale Fish Market, and prepared foods perfect for dinner. You can also find baked goods, candles, personal care products, and more. You can even take advantage of convenient services like on-site knife sharpening while you shop. On the first and second Wednesdays of each month, enjoy live entertainment that adds to the vibrant, community atmosphere of the market. Whether you’re shopping for the week, grabbing a bite, or simply enjoying the park, the Hamilton Park Farmers Market is a welcoming space to connect with local vendors and neighbors.

jc_culture_42883_2026_11_18_jodeci_jerse.title: Jodeci – Jersey City

jc_culture_42883_2026_11_18_jodeci_jerse.summary: Get ready to experience an unforgettable night as Jodeci takes the stage for their highly anticipated concert, “”Jodeci – Jersey City,”” at the iconic Landmark Loews Theatre. Nestled in the heart of Jersey City, this historic venue boasts a stunning atmosphere that perfectly complements the smooth R&B vibes of the legendary group. With its grand architecture and intimate setting, the Loews Theatre is the ideal backdrop for an evening filled with soulful melodies and nostalgic hits. Join fellow fans for a night of electrifying performances that will have you singing along and dancing in your seat. The energy will be palpable as Jodeci delivers their timeless classics and new favorites, making this a must-see event for R&B lovers. Don’t miss out on this chance to witness music history in the making—secure your spot now and be part of the magic at Jodeci – Jersey City!
